metadata.title: Trust Framework — API Resource Meta Data

content.title: Trust Framework — API Resource Meta Data

intro.text: Each API resource registered in the Trust Framework carries a metadata schema specific to its API family. These metadata fields are surfaced in the directory and via GET /participants, allowing TPPs to discover your institution's capabilities and configuration.
The metadata schemas described below correspond to version 2.1 of the Open Finance UAE standards. The full schema definitions can be retrieved programmatically via GET /references/apifamilies.

sections.heading: Where to enter values in the directory

items: Click the actions menu on the API resource and select Configure API Metadata.
Enter the metadata fields for the API family. The required fields vary per family — see the sections below for details.

rows: Account sub-types supported for data sharing. One or more of: CurrentAccount, Savings, CreditCard, Mortgage, Finance

The cost per API call (in AED) for each data sharing transactional data request when usage limits have been exceeded (15 pages per customer per day for attended calls, or 5 pages per customer per day for unattended calls). Format: up to 16 digits with 2 decimal places (e.g. 0.50 )

The date ( YYYY-MM-DD ) from which this API version or resource is officially deprecated. After this date, no new consents SHOULD be created for this family, and migration to a newer version is strongly recommended. The API remains functional for existing users until the Retirement Date

The date ( YYYY-MM-DD ) on which this API version or resource will be permanently retired and become unavailable. After this date, requests will fail, and any existing consents or integrations will cease to function. TPPs MUST complete migration before this date

sections.heading: Payment Initiation metadata — declare supported types and consent models

blocks.text: The payment family declares which payment types and consent models your institution supports. All payment type fields are required — set Supported to false for payment types you do not support.
These payment types require a single Supported boolean:

rows: true if single instant payments are supported
true if fixed amount payments on a defined schedule are supported
true if variable amount payments on a defined schedule are supported
true if fixed amount periodic payments are supported
true if variable amount periodic payments are supported
true if fixed amount on-demand payments are supported

blocks.text: These payment types require additional detail about which beneficiary models are supported:

rows: true if variable on-demand consents support a single beneficiary
true if variable on-demand consents support multiple beneficiaries (2–10)
true if variable on-demand consents support unrestricted beneficiaries defined at the point of payment
true if delegated authentication consents support a single beneficiary
true if delegated authentication consents support multiple beneficiaries (2–10)
true if delegated authentication consents support unrestricted beneficiaries defined at the point of payment
